title: Order lookup becomes async two hops away from the page being extended

agents.task: In src/lib/db.ts, make findOrder asynchronous: declare it `async` and change its return type to `Promise<OrderRecord | undefined>`, simulating a database round trip with `await Promise.resolve()` before the lookup. Keep OrderRecord and the seed data unchanged. Do not touch other files.

In src/app/orders/page.tsx, extend OrdersPage so it takes an optional list of order ids (defaulting to ['ord_1']) and returns one line per order, each line being the result of orderSummary for that id, joined with '\n'; when the list is empty return 'No orders'. Keep orderSummary in src/lib/orders.ts working. Do not touch src/lib/db.ts.
